starterFaqs.question: What if I do not know my admin login?
starterFaqs.answer: Maine Cyber Tech can help identify the right account owner and coordinate safe access separately. Do not submit passwords through public forms.

starterFaqs.question: Does this include hardware?
starterFaqs.answer: Hardware, licenses, subscriptions, and third-party fees are not included unless explicitly stated.

starterFaqs.question: Is this remote or onsite?
starterFaqs.answer: Many services can start remotely. Onsite work depends on the service scope and location.
